title: Split large integration test files by behavior area
description: Reduce test-file coupling so future behavior changes can run targeted package tests without editing broad integration files.

files.change: Split fallback, plugin provider request, session context, provider preference, quote context, and error policy tests.
Split registry, manager, sink, console, webchat, and onebot tests.
Split config, lifecycle, provider bucket, platform, policy, and webchat tests.

criteria: Shared fixtures are local helpers, not new production abstractions.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test -p astrbot-runtime
